  id = {EDN-53},
  title = {\texorpdfstring{\texttt{train.\allowbreak{}num\_\allowbreak{}threads}}{train.num\_threads} is pinned to 1},
  note = {\textbf{Absorbs EDN-56} (2026-09-30): \texttt{model.\allowbreak{}json} carries provenance, so the reproducibility claim is about the predictions and the payload file.},
  date = {2026-09-30},
  milestone = {M3: Quality Assurance},
  topic = {Reproducibility, Modelling Approach},
  participants = {@lukas2510},
  decision = {\texttt{train.\allowbreak{}num\_\allowbreak{}threads} in \texttt{params.\allowbreak{}yaml} is 1 and is passed to LightGBM, so the fitted \texttt{booster.\allowbreak{}txt} is byte-identical on any machine.
\texttt{models/\allowbreak{}<variant>/\allowbreak{}model.\allowbreak{}json} carries \texttt{trained\_\allowbreak{}at} and the MLflow run id, so the model directory as a whole is not byte-reproducible.
NFR-06 is asserted on the predictions and on the payload file.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item LightGBM's default of every core: it writes the thread count into \texttt{booster.\allowbreak{}txt}, so the DVC hash would depend on who ran the pipeline.
\item A pin of 2 or 4 threads: faster, but machine-independent only where that many cores exist.
\item Provenance outside the bundle: the API image has no MLflow client and no \texttt{dvc.\allowbreak{}lock}, and still has to say which model it serves.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} The trees do not depend on the thread count; only the recorded setting does, and DVC hashes the file.
1 is the only value every machine can honour.
A pinned 2 to 4 threads would fit faster, and that is the cost we accept.},
  ai = {Information seeking, Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation, Solution generation},
  response = {Accepted with modifications},
  assessment = {AI found that LightGBM records the thread count in the artefact and proposed the pin.
Three of its supporting claims were wrong and were corrected by measuring: which flags make the trees thread-independent, that the pin costs nothing, and how it compares with the default.
The decision held and its stated reasons changed.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code sessions of 2026-09-30 on issue \#37 and on the review of PR \#62.},
